:::{#cor-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome in terms of the precision and deviation

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$
and [precision](#def-precision-rv) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$,
its [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution is, with the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs \eqdef \outvar_\iobs - \prob$:

$$\hess_\iobs(\prob) = -\precision - \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision} \devn_\iobs$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision.
It follows from @thm-bernoulli-hessian-contribution.

:::
